FIELD OPERATIONS / ART MODULE / 2.1.2

Give every entry a face.

Install 32 original atmospheric concept scenes on your existing Active Matter Field Operations guide. No cloud uploads, no game injection and no subscriptions. The installer reads your chosen guide only inside this browser and creates a new downloadable HTML file.

Original conceptual art · 16 fresh scenes + 16 classic

All scenes are artist-generated interpretations, not screenshots, accurate weapon models, or authentic map basemaps. Entries reuse category scenes where appropriate.

Upgrade your guide

Before updating, use the guide’s Backup tab to export your saved progress. Then choose the original 2.1.1 (or 2.0) standalone guide HTML. Your original file stays unchanged.

Map evidence: This upgrade adds a convenient visual location picker and links to the community atlas. It does not replace any of the 14 illustrated maps or pretend that uncertain building geometry is accurate. Use your own game screenshots in the guide’s already-available “My screenshot” and alignment tools.
